notes.title: The Last Tinker New Patch Version is now available!
notes.notes:
Hey there Tinkers,

yeah I know, there was a long silence on this game from our side. As you may know we were busy making Shadow Tactics and now we are full force working on our next title codenamed Kartoffel. But somehow we found a little time to do a small patch for The Last Tinker.

The main thing this patch does is fixing the problem a lot of you had with using their controllers to play the game. With this new patch it should be possible to play the game with almost every controller.

For now that´s all for The Last Tinker. But if you are interested in getting in touch with us about anything that´s on your mind, I´d really love to see you on our Discord server:

[url=https://discord.gg/uytjwD8]https://discord.gg/uytjwD8[/url]

And just in case your a super hardcore Mimi, feel free to subscribe to our exclusive mailing list:

[url=http://mail.shadow-tactics.com]mail.shadow-tactics.com[/url]

[b]PLEASE NOTE: If you experience issues on your Mac System with this new version, please try switching back to the old version which is available on the beta branch called "troubleshooting".[/b]
Instructions on how to switch to a beta branch on Steam can be found here for our other game, Shadow Tactics: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/418240/discussions/0/3377008022039876392/]http://steamcommunity.com/app/418240/discussions/0/3377008022039876392/[/url]

Cheers from Germany,
The Mimimis

notes.title: Squash those bugs!
notes.notes:
[h1]Did you have problems playing our joyous platformer, inspired by classics such as [b]Jak and Daxter and Banjo Kazooie[/b]?[/h1]

Thanks to the continuous feedback of our gamers we've been able to find and solve all the bugs that we are aware of. We also improved some features:

- Fixed a bug that would cause the game to freeze after selecting the difficulty in the main menu.
- A bug that could corrupt your save game in the Cave levels has been fixed.
- Mashing the "Use"-button will now skip dialogues faster.
- Koru's respawn behaviour has been improved to be more intuitive.
- The Security System occasionally didn't stop shooting, which has been fixed.
- Jumping from a Jump Pad sometimes didn't stop the "flying through the air" sounds after landing.

Please keep the feedback coming. [b]We love to hear from you![/b]

notes.title: Pre-Purchase Now - The Last Tinker™: City of Colors
notes.notes:
The Last Tinker™: City of Colors is Now Available for Pre-Purchase on Steam and is 10% off!*

The Last Tinker is a colorful adventure set in Colortown, a world built upon creativity, emotion and collaboration.

A dark force named The Bleakness has emerged and seeks to tear the colors apart, draining all joy and life from the world.
Koru, a young boy from the slums of Colortown, is forced to act. He embarks on an epic and one of a kind adventure to combat the Bleakness and to restore joy and color to his home.
